name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The candidate matches the task. R1 RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) captures 'if you move the ball, you must also take the key' (the 'also' cue gives no-timing). The 'Then' links the second sentence, so target_picked_up is a hard goal with Existence (R2), ordered after the key (R3 Precedence) and after moving the ball when it happens (R4 Response), exactly as the compilation rule for a sentence after an 'if' prescribes. Although R1 is flagged redundant, it is an 'if' rule stated by the task, so it stays.

texts: If the blocking ball is moved, the matching door key must also be taken at some point.
Take the matching door key before picking up the target box.
If the blocking ball is moved, the target box must be picked up afterwards.
